title: Secrets of RLHF in Large Language Models Part I: PPO
models_tested: SFT models (based on LLaMA and OpenChineseLLaMA)
RLHF models (PPO-max, based on SFT models)
findings: The paper reports no findings related to religion. The only mention of a religious group ('Iraqi Christians') was in a sample response to illustrate a flaw in the reward model, not as part of a systematic analysis.
